audit.whatIsWrong: Rated HARD 8.5/10 with six of seven stages given to Vayne, against a 51.52% Cho'Gath win rate over 656 games.
audit.why: The chart also contradicts the page's own whys, which call level 1 even, level 3 'a wash', levels 4-5 'even', and level 6 a real kill threat.
audit.corrected: EVEN, 5.5/10; chart Skill / Vayne / Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Vayne with ratings 5,4,5,5,6,6,3. Late still belongs to Vayne, so carryRating stays 9.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were named but never anchored to cooldowns.
audit.why: Tumble falls 6/5/4/3/2s and Condemn 20/18/16/14/12s, and Final Hour (100/85/70s) further reduces Tumble's cooldown and makes it an invisibility. Those numbers define the punish windows.
audit.corrected: Levels 2-3 are hers on a 6s Tumble; 6 and first item are yours; two items and Final Hour return the lane to her.

audit.whatIsWrong: The range asymmetry was never stated anywhere: Rupture reaches 950 and Condemn only 550. Tumble's auto-attack reset was also never given as the burst tell.
audit.why: Cho'Gath can open the trade from outside Vayne's only defensive tool. Tumble is flagged autoReset, so the attack wind-up is the tell rather than the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Open Rupture at 950, outside Condemn's 550; treat the Tumble wind-up as the cue to step back; Feral Scream denies both Tumble and Condemn; Feast is true damage through her armour and MR.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to stack HP without warning what that does against Silver Bolts.
audit.why: Silver Bolts is percentage-max-health true damage, so Feast stacks and tank items increase the damage she deals rather than reduce it.
audit.corrected: Named it in the don'ts: HP feeds Silver Bolts, it does not blunt it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Final Hour's invisibility-on-Tumble was mentioned only obliquely.
audit.why: Cho'Gath has no stealth reveal in his kit, so a Tumble under Final Hour ends any chase.
audit.corrected: Stated in the don'ts that you cannot follow a Final Hour Tumble.

edits.before: Level 1 is roughly even — you both have one ability and no real all-in, so last-hit, let Carnivore top off your HP and mana, and don't walk into her autos. The danger starts at 2-3: her third Silver Bolt does percent-max-HP true damage that laughs at your health, and her Q tumble lets her dance back the instant Rupture's delayed telegraph appears, so a missed knockup just feeds her free poke. Don't throw Rupture on cooldown to push — hold it as your one engage-and-disengage threat and farm at max range with Vorpal Spikes.
edits.after: Level 1 is roughly even - you both have one ability and no real all-in, so last-hit, let Carnivore top off your HP and mana, and don't walk into her autos. The danger starts at 2-3: her third Silver Bolt does percent-max-HP true damage that laughs at your health bar, and Tumble is a 6-second auto-attack reset at rank 1, so the attack wind-up - not the ability cast - is your cue to step back, and she can roll straight out of a Rupture you telegraph. Don't throw Rupture on cooldown to push; it reaches 950 while Condemn only reaches 550, and that gap is the whole matchup.

edits.before: By 4-5 your Carnivore sustain, Vorpal Spikes waveclear, and Rupture-into-Feral-Scream combo stabilize the lane and you can shove her in. Level 6 is your window: Feast is true damage her armor and MR cannot reduce, so if she greeds for a stack of CS in your range, a Rupture knockup into Feral Scream silence locks her out of tumble and condemn, and the execute can flat kill her. Bait the condemn (E) — once it's down she has no panic button to wall you — then commit and shove to deny her item timers.

Level 6 is your window: Feast is true damage her armour and MR cannot reduce, so open Rupture from 950 - outside Condemn's 550 - and chain Feral Scream, which denies Tumble and Condemn both, then execute. Bait Condemn first if you can: it is a 20-second cooldown at rank 1, and once it is gone she has no panic button at all.

notes: Kit-flag misfires I wrote around. (1) chogath.json tags Rupture (Q) with grounding, but Riot's text is 'Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air' - the parser fired on the word 'ground'. The same false positive hits Malphite Q and Olaf Q. Rupture's real interaction is the knockup, and that is all I asserted. (2) vayne.json tags Condemn (E) with 'terrain: creates terrain'; the description says the opposite - it stuns only if the target collides with existing terrain. I wrote the collision, not terrain creation. The packet's three suspectNames for this matchup ('Silver Bolt's', 'Feral Scream's', 'Silver Bolt') are all false positives - they are possessive or singular forms of correct names.
